reviewer: Astra independent Stanford EE appointment review
independence: Read only person_id, name, profile_url, original_title, source_key and source_locator from the Stanford neutral roster; existing category/included/decision fields were not inspected. Classifications independently established from fresh official sources.
policy: Official EE departmental membership and explicit central academic appointments control. Include regular non-courtesy EE appointments even when jointly appointed to CS or another department. Research-only kept separate; leave does not remove appointment. No paper-topic evidence used.

coverage.outside_active_directory_categories: All 89 additional entries are explicitly Courtesy or Emeritus; none is an additional regular EE professor.
coverage.scope_limit: Complete against the live official EE active directory and all-directory categories on the observation date, not an independent HR census. Additional 89 courtesy/emeritus records are a completeness cross-check, not individually central-profile audited.

sources.fact: 60 entries, no pager; exact equality with neutral roster names.
